# Benchmark Results

**Last updated:** 2025-12-29 20:09:18

**Environment:**
- PHP 8.5.1 on Linux
- Serializor: v2.0.0-RC1
- Opis/Closure: 4.4.0
- Laravel Serializable Closure: v2.0.7

## Library Comparison

| Feature | Serializor | Opis | Laravel |
|---------|------------|------|--------|
| Transparent serialization | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ (requires wrapper) |
| Named functions | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| First-class callables | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Objects containing closures | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |
| Closures with shared state | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ |

> **Note:** Laravel's SerializableClosure requires explicitly wrapping each closure before serialization.
> It cannot transparently serialize data structures containing closures, objects with closure properties,
> or first-class callables (e.g., `strlen(...)`, `$obj->method(...)`).

## Summary
